## Helper (HelperPinguino, owner: Helper fork of 02)

Engine: `HelperPinguino\PinguinoHelper.cs` (C# 7.3; an INDEX block with line numbers sits at the top of the file). Tests: `Tests\helper\run-helper-tests.ps1` (harness.cs), `python -I Tools\test-helper-pack.py`.

| Area | Where |
|---|---|
| Message pipeline, gates, cooldowns, opt-outs | `Handle()` / `HandleCore()` |
| `!helper` / `!ask` / `!pinguino` (pack answers, tiers, unanswered log) | section "!helper <question>" |
| Random chime (rate-limited tips, never for opted-out / !unping) | `TryChime`, `OptedOutOfBots` |
| Context gate, lobby/join/register help, Minecraft + site facts, Taught notes | sections of the same names |
| Help-review log (private) | `Data\helper\review.jsonl`, browsed at /helper-review (Host `HostHelperReview.cs`) |
| Settings | `HelperSettings` (`Data\runtime\helper_settings.json`) |

Knowledge pack (PUBLIC material only goes through these):
- Builder `Tools\build-helper-pack.py` -> `Data\helper\knowledge.json` (public tier) and `knowledge_mod.json` (mod tier, role >= 3). Rebuilt nightly (`Docs\NIGHTLY_CHECKLIST.md`).
- Hand-written public summaries: `Docs\HELPER_PUBLIC.md` (one `## Title` per entry). Mod how-tos: `Docs\HELPER_MOD.md`.
- Other sources: `PinguinoB0t\commands.json`, `Data\runtime\helper_facts.json` (+ Taught), `links.json`, `channel_lore.json` (info + link, publicSafe), site FAQ.
- Never in the public pack: secrets, `Data\lore`, raw logs, opted-out people, internal architecture (enforced by the builder, checked by the leak test).
- Unanswered questions: `Docs\nightly\YYYY-MM-DD.md`, section "Helper unanswered".

## Suite shell, core and Listen (owner: 01)
Each big file below starts with its own INDEX block (routes/functions with line numbers).
- `App/src/index.html` - the shell UI (single file, Tauri webview). Pages `pages.*` (dashboard, comm, quick, voice, accounts, approvals, integrations, activity, console, help, personalize, settings). Talks to the core on `127.0.0.1:8760`; Host calls go through `/api/modules/host/get|post` (`hostGet`, `hostPost`, `hostJ`).
- `App/src/theme.css`, `App/src/bootstrap.js` - theme and boot script. `App/src-tauri/` - Tauri v2 shell.
- `Suite/suite/suite.py` - core (FastAPI, port 8760): supervises modules, module tokens, live detection, vault/help/prestream/devices/console/integrations APIs, `/api/modules/{id}/get|post` proxy.
- `Suite/suite/vault.py` (encrypted secret vault, `/api/vault/{name}` readable only by the declaring module), `helpdb.py` (help entries), `prestream.py` (pre-stream checks), `device.py` (master/auxiliary roles, peers), `consolelog.py` (Console, `<data>/console/<module>.jsonl`), `integrations.py`, `prefs.py`, `portable.py` (export/import), `livedetect.py`.
- `Suite/modules.json` - module manifests (CRLF file): id, port, url, secrets (name/label/help), UI nav. Contract: `Docs/MODULE_CONTRACT.md`.
- `Suite/modules/listen/` - PinguinoListen (port 8765): `server.py` (API), `live.py` (mic: `resolve_device`, `candidates`, silence watchdog), `asr.py`, `ingest.py`, `learn.py`, `twitch.py`, `voice.py`, `config.py`, `db.py`, `static/index.html` (Listen page). Settings: `Suite/modules/listen/data/settings.json`.
- Ports: core 8760, Listen 8765, Multi 8766, Host 8770, Voice 8772.
- Tests: `Suite/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m unittest discover -s Suite/tests` (mic, listen_db, supervisor, vault, help, prestream, device, portable, prefs).
- Safety nets: Listen `db.rows_nowait` + `/api/status` `stats_busy` (status never hangs behind a long DB job); core `Module.start` refuses to spawn when the module's port is already held by a hung copy and warns in Console (source `supervisor`).
- Shell Approvals tab (`pages.approvals`, `bindApprovals`) reads the Host Teach inbox: `GET /api/teach?status=`, `POST /api/teach/decide`.

**Other public pages (not in the sitemap):** `/members` + `/members/<name>` (profiles, `/member/<name>` redirects), `/help/ticket`, `/settings` (login), `/mod-apply` (login), `/nominations`, `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/shop` (HIDDEN until the owner sets shopOpen; noindex), `/overlay/wheel` `/overlay/subgoal` `/overlay/activity` `/overlay/music` (OBS browser sources, noindex), `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`.

**API route groups (all JSON; mutating calls need same-site Origin):** `/api/me` `/api/settings` `/api/prefs` `/api/site-config` (login/prefs/options) | `/auth/<twitch|youtube|kick|tiktok>/*` (sign-in) | `/api/customs/*` (pages) and `/api/bot/*` (bot polls with Bearer BOT_API_KEY: state, results, commands, boards, profiles, standings, matches, events, shop, balances, supporters, wheel, emotes, member-info, log jobs) | `/api/league` `/api/matches` `/api/poll*` `/api/tourney*` `/api/wheel/*` `/api/spotify/*` `/api/activity` `/api/news` `/api/faq` `/api/game` `/api/emotes` `/api/stream-status` `/api/live-pages` | `/api/tickets*` `/api/mod/*` `/api/log` `/api/chatlogs` `/api/roles` `/api/nominations*` (staff or login) | `/api/shop/*` (hidden).
